title.narrative: Turkey's National Assisted Voluntary Return and Reintegration mechanism

description.narrative: NY: The overall objective is to contribute to voluntary, dignified and sustainable return of irregular migrants from Türkiye to main Countries of Origin. This is done, among other things, through contributing to further development and operationalization of Turkey’s N-AVRR (National Assisted Voluntary Return and Reintegration) mechanism, and overall AVRR policies and strategies, strengthening of return and reintegration capacities of the N-AVRR stakeholders to uphold international standards in the pre-return and post-arrival phases, develop operational capacities for enabling an increase in voluntary return and sustainable reintegration of irregular migrants from Türkiye, outreach to prospective returnees and communication of the N-AVRR, and facilitating and enhancing bilateral cooperation between Türkiye and targeted Countries of Origin. Through this mechanism, stakeholders are working to ensuring a system founded on the principle of voluntariness and preparedness of the returnees, to respect the principles of human rights and human dignity, and to contribute to the sustainable reintegration of returnees into their communities and to the development of the countries of origin
